quote: In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours. In all the world, there is no love for you like mine.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Whatever our souls are made of, yours and mine are the same.
author: Emily Brontë

quote: I saw that you were perfect, and so I loved you. Then I saw that you were not perfect and I loved you even more.
author: Angelita Lim

quote: You are my heart, my life, my one and only thought.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle

quote: I have found the one whom my soul loves.
author: Song of Solomon

quote: You don't love someone for their looks, or their clothes, or for their fancy car, but because they sing a song only you can hear.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
author: David Viscott

quote: Loved you yesterday, love you still, always have, always will.
author: Elaine Davis

quote: I love you not only for what you are, but for what I am when I am with you.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: If I had a flower for every time I thought of you... I could walk through my garden forever.
author: Alfred Tennyson

quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: You are the finest, loveliest, tenderest, and most beautiful person I have ever known—and even that is an understatement.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quote: I would rather spend one lifetime with you, than face all the ages of this world alone.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quote: My heart is and always will be yours.
author: Jane Austen

quote: When I look at you, I see the rest of my life in front of my eyes.
author: Unknown

quote: You are my today and all of my tomorrows.
author: Leo Christopher

quote: Love is not about how many days, months, or years you have been together. Love is about how much you love each other every single day.
author: Unknown

quote: I swear I couldn't love you more than I do right now, and yet I know I will tomorrow.
author: Leo Christopher

quote: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite.
author: SainiVerse Sanctuary

quote: You make me want to be a better man every single day.
author: Jack Nicholson

quote: In your smile I see something more beautiful than the stars.
author: Beth Revis

quote: The simple lack of her is more to me than others' presence.
author: Edward Thomas

quote: I look at you and I'm home.
author: Dory

quote: Together is my favorite place to be.
author: Unknown

quote: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: For the two of us, home isn't a place. It is a person. And we are finally home.
author: Stephanie Perkins

quote: To the world you may be one person, but to one person you are the world.
author: Bill Wilson

quote: I fell in love the way you fall asleep: slowly, and then all at once.
author: John Green

quote: You are the piece of me I will always need.
author: Unknown

quote: Walking with your hands in mine is the sweetest path in the universe.
author: Saini & Jith

quote: Two souls with but a single thought, two hearts that beat as one.
author: John Keats
